description: Aménagements cyclables (Le Mans Métropole) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Le Mans Métropole. It lists the geolocated cycling facilities: some values are zero given the lack of development on one side of the track. In addition, 11 sections do not have a local identifier assigned. Coverage: Le Mans Métropole. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling facilities (Le Mans Métropole)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Le Mans Métropole. Its keywords include cyclable, amenagements-cyclables, piste-cyclable, le-mans, espace-cyclable, amenagement-urbain. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2026-07-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
